displayName: Quarry Street Exchange corporate treasury wallet

custody.story: The exchange's own money. Any two of the three officers must approve a movement, so no single officer can empty the treasury.

placeholders.reason: No multi-sig account exists yet. Midnight has no native multi-signature account or account abstraction, so this wallet must be a Compact contract that counts approvals. That contract has not been written or deployed.
placeholders.unblockedBy: Write and deploy a multi-party authorization contract on pre-prod, then record its contract address here.

placeholders.reason: Nothing is funded. The signer keys are real pre-prod addresses holding no tNIGHT.
placeholders.unblockedBy: Fund the signers from the faucet or a funded wallet.

placeholders.reason: Not verified here that a contract on current pre-prod can hold tNIGHT on behalf of its signers. Midnight's own contract-custody account design (Midnight Passport, MIP-0012 and MIP-0013) was at the Proposed stage and Stagenet-only as of 3 Oct 2026.
placeholders.unblockedBy: Confirm against the current support matrix, then test with a small funded contract.
